notes.title: WHO IS AWESOME Released!
notes.content:
[b]WHO IS AWESOME[/b] is a singleplayer mini-game collection, in which the most awesome character that you choose competes with the characters that you didn’t.

Four characters from different games — Reaper from [b]Peace, Death![/b], Vladimir from [b]DRAW CHILLY[/b], Knight from [b]OH MY GOD, LOOK AT THIS KNIGHT![/b], and the Cowboy from [b]Gun Done[/b] — sit at the same table and try to think faster than their opponents.

[h1]The game has only two rules[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rule number one: if you lose, the others will win.
[*]Rule number two: if you win, the others will lose.
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7wJLAZgyuT4

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33751114/284122d972716b43603ab595a52890ef50db06e6.png[/img]

notes.title: Special bundle for Peace, Death! owners
notes.content:
Hello there, Reapers.
Who are the most nice people who supports AZAMATIKA? Who bought our game to give us happiness, bliss and motivation (except our friends in reality)?
You are! I mean even those who left negative reviews, because why not?
So, Reapers, there's a surprise stuff.
On release every owner of Peace, Death! can obtain DRAW CHILLY with additional discount. There's no coupons in your inventory, just discount in a new bundle (will be available on 12 november).
You know. Bundle. Discount. We are creating AZAMATIKA UNIVERSE together!
Really, we create it, you play in it. That's fair, that's nice too.
Thanks.
Wait.
12.
November.
Of.
2019.

P.S.: We added Turkish localization.
